calculation.description: Cross-asset residual reversal scaled by a robust rolling median absolute deviation blended with total volatility. The signal is active only when 20-session cross-sectional dispersion is at or above its trailing 252-session median, and is lagged one completed session to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Primary 10-session IC and ICIR clear benchmark gates of absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Positive across recent 365, 730, and 1095-session windows; small 15-asset cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
